proposals.premise: Visitors can just arrive, so help them choose an entrance first.
proposals.opening: Desktop pairs the entry photo with the two routes. Phone shows five steps at the main entrance and the step-free library courtyard route above the photo. Both show doors 09:00–17:00 and quiet hour 13:00–14:00.
proposals.move: Tap “Step-free entrance” to reveal “Go through the library courtyard and ring the bell” beneath the route. The optional volunteer request shows your selected arrival time and requires 30 minutes’ notice.
proposals.tradeoff: The route is quick to find. On phones, the photo sits farther down.

proposals.premise: Visitors may still be deciding when to come. Quiet hour gives them a reason to start with the time.
proposals.opening: Desktop pairs the door, bells and curb photo with hours and both routes. Phone leads with doors 09:00–17:00, quiet hour 13:00–14:00 and “Just arrive,” then shows the photo beside the entrance notes.
proposals.move: Choose an arrival time. The time appears beside “Request a volunteer,” with the 30-minute notice requirement. The entrance notes show five steps at the main door and bell access through the step-free library courtyard.
proposals.tradeoff: Timing is easier to compare. Entrance details sit lower on phones.
